## Objective

Combine canonical sampling, mixture terms, source weights and tiny rigid matrices into an immutable-state/reusable-scratch evaluation path. Preserve all invalid patch costs while accumulating data gradient/curvature and physical geometry metrics.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 6, 7, FA-04. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `rigid streaming evaluation`
- `linearization cache`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Full objective/gradient/GN matrices agree with explicit reference on physical phantoms and outlier cases.
2. No nonlinear basis, Krylov state, dense warp or per-sample generic model dispatch is instantiated.
3. Counters and cache identities expose all sampling and data-only information.

## Blocking prerequisites

- L02 (`bd-01M2B114KAY698DFMNFZ1WMVEE`): FA-L02: Implement streamed rigid/affine sufficient statistics
- L07 (`bd-01M2B1157SE4NYGY8W02MYHQS2`): FA-L07: Implement frozen weighted sample sets and holdout roles
- L08 (`bd-01M2B115BGWNTNW4XAZG9R751R`): FA-L08: Deduplicate exact sample points and reuse affine stencil geometry
- L09 (`bd-01M2B115FNTEBWATG71TDVBNSJ`): FA-L09: Implement physical rigid updates and analytic intensity Jacobians

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
